slice: Natural conversation round 19: natural handling of short acknowledgments

before.got it: I don't have a good answer on got yet — what's it like from your side?
before.sure: Hey! Nice to meet you. I'm Novo, and I'm curious — what brings you here today?

mechanism: short acknowledgments ('okay/sure/got it/sounds good') get a brief natural reply instead of a topic follow-up ('no good answer on got') or a forced introduction
